title: Pure Plunder Patroll
summary: Pure Plunder Patroll with Salamangreat Almiraj and generic staples. The Level 4 WATER Fiend crew cheat out Extra Deck ships that match the Attributes of the opponent's monsters, then equip themselves from the GY to unlock each ship's Quick Effect.

summary.title: Starters
points: Plunder Patroll Shipyarrrd discards a card to search any Plunder Patroll card, boosts all Plunder Patroll monsters by 500 ATK per Plunder Patroll card in your Spell & Trap Zone, and returns from the GY by bouncing an equipped card.

Goldenhair, the Newest Plunder Patroll sends another Plunder Patroll Monster Card from the hand or face-up field to the GY to Special Summon itself, then discards a card to revive itself from the GY as a Level 4 Tuner.

Bluebeard, the Plunder Patroll Shipwright Special Summons itself while you control another Plunder Patroll monster and discards to draw a card when sent from the field to the GY. Blackeyes, the Plunder Patroll Seaguide returns a crew member from the GY to the hand to summon itself.

summary.title: Opening: Goldenhair + Any Crew Member
steps: Normal Summon Whitebeard, the Plunder Patroll Helm (or Redbeard) and link it off for Salamangreat Almiraj, or pair it with Goldenhair or Bluebeard.

Whitebeard triggers in the GY to Special Summon a Plunder Patroll monster from the Deck, converting into Blackbeard, the Plunder Patroll Captain or Synchro Summoning Plunder Patrollship Jord with a Level 4 Tuner and non-Tuner.

Activate Jord's effect to recycle a Plunder Patroll card and place two Plunder Patroll monsters as Pendulum Scales, leaving Blackbeard, Whitebeard or Redbeard ready to tag into a ship on the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Tagging Out & Attribute Matching
summary.text: On the opponent's turn, Whitebeard and Redbeard Quick Effect cheat out a Plunder Patroll Extra Deck monster sharing an Attribute with a monster the opponent controls or has in their GY, then equip themselves to that ship. Blackbeard, the Plunder Patroll Captain does the same for any Effect Monster you control and draws a card. When the opponent lacks the Attribute you need, Plunder Patroll Booty changes one of their face-up monsters to any Attribute for the turn, or Plunder Patrollship Jord gives them a Token of the Attribute you want.

summary.title: The Fleet (Extra Deck Bosses)
points: Plunder Patrollship Jord (EARTH Synchro) adds a Plunder Patroll card from the Deck whenever the opponent Special Summons, plus an extra crew member from the Deck if Jord is equipped with a Plunder Patroll card.

Plunder Patrollship Lys (LIGHT Fusion) Special Summons an equipped Plunder Patroll monster during either Main Phase, and discards a Plunder Patroll card to negate a monster effect and destroy it if equipped.
Plunder Patrollship Moerk (DARK Rank 4) discards a Plunder Patroll card to banish an opposing Effect Monster and searches a Plunder Patroll Spell/Trap, as a Quick Effect while equipped.
Plunder Patrollship Brann (FIRE Synchro) discards a Plunder Patroll card to banish an opposing Spell/Trap and searches a Plunder Patroll monster, as a Quick Effect while equipped.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Emblem of the Plunder Patroll boosts a monster's ATK and makes it untargetable, then sends itself to the GY to summon a Plunder Patroll ship matching an Attribute on either field or in either GY and equips the previously equipped monster to it.
Plunder Patroll Shipshape Ships Shipping Fusion Summons Lys, then banishes itself from the GY to equip a Plunder Patroll monster or Emblem from the Deck straight onto a Plunder Patroll monster.

Plunder Patroll Parrrty draws cards equal to your Plunder Patroll Equip Cards, and Pride of the Plunder Patroll draws on battle kills or sends itself to inspect and strip the opponent's hand or Extra Deck.
